notes.title: Update – Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
Improved tooltip design
 Added tooltips to in-game UI buttons
 Refined tooltips in the menu
 Added camera view switch button in LOCAL mode
 Added resign and restart options to all modes except Multiplayer (coming soon)
 Improved UI window design

notes.title: Update – Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
Updated light and camera icons (bottom panel)
 Added black bar (top panel)
 Updated black pawn icon
 Verified achievements can be unlocked without issues
 Added "Change Difficulty" button at end screen redirecting to difficulty selection

notes.title: Update – Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
Renamed "Moves List" to "Ply List" in all game modes
Updated Ply List behavior: shows target square (`1. E4`) and opponent moves as continuation (`1… D6`)
Captures marked with `X`, e.g., `XE4`
Improved layout of the right UI panel

notes.title: Update – Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
Gameplay

 Tweaked AI reaction time and depth
 Disabled move highlighting in Advanced & GM
 Added lighting option in Intermediate
 Added toggle for move hints (Beginner, Intermediate, Local, Multiplayer)


UI

 Adjusted position of "THE OPPONENT IS ANALYZING"
 Repositioned lighting & camera icons
 Adjusted white light color and intensity
 Improved arrow symbols placement

notes.title: Update – Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
Gameplay

 Highlight added for the currently selected piece in 2D view.
 Added a button to switch lighting mode during gameplay (lightbulb icon in the bottom-left corner).
 Camera position centered and improved in top-down view.


Menu

 UI elements centered; alignment improved.


Multiplayer

 Updated fonts and colors of messages for better readability in lobby.
 Added LEAVE button to quickly exit lobby.
 Pressing ESC now opens an exit window to confirm leaving the lobby.
